title: What if the Moon vanished?
description: What would really happen if the Moon disappeared tomorrow?

scenes.say: What if the Moon disappeared tomorrow?
Our nights would become much darker, but the stars would shine brighter.
The Moon pulls the oceans, so tides would shrink to about a third.
Earth's tilt could slowly wobble, and seasons would be harder to predict.
But do not worry, the Moon is not going anywhere.
